title: Chapter 670 - 670 Ranking; Forbidden Area No. 2
content:
Chapter 670 - 670 Ranking; Forbidden Area No. 2

Chapter 670 - 670 Ranking; Forbidden Area No. 2

670 Ranking; Forbidden Area No. 2

At this moment, Li Ke, who was deep in thought, suddenly had his phone ring in his pocket.

He looked at the caller ID, and his expression suddenly became serious. He quickly pressed the answer button.

“Yes, Sir!

“Yes, Sir!

“Understood!”

Li Ke answered a few times before hanging up.

After hanging up the phone, his expression was no longer as relaxed as before.

He looked very anxious.

In fact, similar things did not only happen to Li Ke.

Almost at the same time, the same thing happened to all the examiners of the joint examination.

Some people seemed to have noticed something.

However, the majority was still immersed in the exciting arena competition.

…

The group arena only lasted for 30 minutes. Amidst the discussions of the crowd, the curtains quickly came to an end.

At this moment, most of the students in Group 7 were in a sorry state.

This was normal.

After all, the group arena required the students to face each other head-on. It was very intense.

Li Ke, who was standing at the front, said bluntly, “Everyone we have your scores for the mecha competition in the morning and the group arena in the afternoon.”

As soon as he finished speaking, a huge 3D projection immediately appeared on the scene, with names and scores.

[Lin Fan: 57]

[Xia Xue: 51]

[Li Dongqiang: 39]

…

About a minute later, Li Ke said again, “Now, the overall ranking of the three schools will be announced!”

As soon as he said this, the students began to discuss.

“Overall ranking? Is it going to be announced directly?”

“But our Group 7 didn’t compete with the other groups?”

“The joint examination of the three schools is about to end?”

…

The entire scene became a little chaotic.

It was no wonder it was like this.

After all, the joint examination of the three schools was an extremely grand event.

It attracted the attention of almost everyone in the world.

Was it going to end in just one day?

This was indeed unexpected.

However, Li Ke did not pay attention to everyone’s discussion.

He casually waved his hand…

Instantly, a new 3D projection appeared in the air.

[Lin Fan: 57]

[Xia Xue: 51]

[Song Bin: 49]

[Sun Daqiang: 40]

[Li Dongqiang: 39]

…

Even in the overall ranking, Lin Fan was still ranked first.

When the people in Group 7 saw his ranking, they were not too surprised.

However, the students from the other groups started discussing again.

“First place, Lin Fan?”

“This… Could it be the hero from a thousand years ago, Professor Lin?”

“Professor Lin is also participating in the joint examination of the three schools?”

“Heavens! This is unbelievable!”

…

In fact, it was not just the students who were surprised.

The examiners were also stunned.

Some of the people who were familiar with Li Ke even sent a message asking about it.

…

At this moment, a loud voice suddenly rang out in the huge Jiangbei University.

“Hello everyone, I’m Hu Yixiao!”

The entire Jiangbei University fell silent.

Everyone’s hearts began to beat faster.

Hu Yixiao!

The current chief!

He was a super expert ranked sixth on the Strength Rankings!

He was an existence that countless people worshipped!

Now, he actually wanted to talk to them!

Hu Yixiao said, “I’ve already watched everyone’s mecha battle and group arena. To be honest, I’m very disappointed!

“You lot are immature and full of flaws!

“The current world has given you the best environment and the best resources, yet this is all you can do?

“I’m very disappointed!”

Everyone’s ears buzzed, and endless guilt rose in their hearts.

Hu Yixiao said after a while, “You don’t know this, but many people are unable to step out of the forbidden area for the rest of their lives in order to stop the forbidden area from expanding!

“You don’t know that countless people die in the mouths of mutated beasts every year!

“Perhaps we’ve been protecting you too well.”

Hu Yixiao let out a long sigh.

“But it’s not too late yet!

“Now, we have a chance! A chance to grow quickly and protect others!

“There’s a mutated beast riot in Forbidden Area No. 2. I’ll lead the way to provide support. Do you dare to go with me?!”

Jiangbei University immediately gave a loud and clear response.

“We’ll go!”

“You’ll have to face the terrifying beasts alone there,” Hu Yixiao said again. “Are you afraid?”

“We’re not afraid!”

“Good!” Hu Yixiao shouted loudly, “The top 500 students will gather at the school gate. The rest of you disperse because you don’t have the qualifications to participate!”

Hu Yixiao’s voice stopped abruptly.

The examiners quickly organized the top 500 students and headed for the school gate.

The students who were ranked below 500 lowered their heads, feeling helpless, bitter, and depressed.

“It’s great that we can go to Forbidden Area No. 2!” Li Dongqiang said excitedly. “It’s said that this is the forbidden area that the heroes had experienced a thousand years ago!”

Lin Fan’s face flashed with a strange expression. However, he did not say anything.

Li Dongqiang patted Tian Zhiwu, who looked a little dejected. He said, “Don’t look so bitter! Although you can’t go, I’ll help you kill a few more exotic beasts. It’ll be considered as you going!”

Tian Zhiwu said, “Okay…?”

Li Dongqiang said, “Look, I’m already helping you. Aren’t you going to thank me?”

The corner of Tian Zhiwu’s mouth twitched slightly, but he said, “Alright, thank you.”

“You’re not sincere at all,” Li Dongqiang said.

Lin Fan could not help but laugh and shake his head when he heard the two of them arguing.

He turned to Xia Xue and said, “Don’t worry. There’ll be no danger.”

Xia Xue, who was still worried, heard this sentence, and the worry in her heart was instantly swept away.

“Yes, yes!” She nodded vigorously.

Everyone talked as they walked. After a while, they arrived at the school gate.

At this moment, a large luxury spacecraft had already stopped in front of them.

When the students saw this, they all exclaimed in admiration.

“It’s the M5 spacecraft!”

“Heavens, this is the first time I’ve seen the real thing!”

“So cool!”

…

When the top 500 students of the three schools were sitting in the M5 aircraft, the Xia Alliance’s headquarters called for an emergency meeting.

“How’s the situation in Forbidden Area No. 2?”

“The energy fluctuations in the core area are getting stronger and stronger. All the exotic beasts are going berserk. Among them, more than a hundred SSS-class exotic beasts appeared!”

As soon as he said that, the atmosphere in the entire meeting room became extremely gloomy.

A million exotic beasts, a hundred SSS-class exotic beasts!

It was very terrifying.

The beasts were all gathered together.

Just thinking about it made one feel despair.
